title: Inertia and weight of a pair bound through the field, full grip

key_results.statement: Half-gap $\sigma_iR_i=\frac{N_f}2[\varepsilon_0(g_i)-\varepsilon_0(-g_i)]=ng_i[1+O(\eta^2)]$, $c_i^2=\sigma_iR_i/\mu_i=\tau_i^2[1+O(N_f\eta^2)]$, the part $M_i^o$ of the mutual term odd in $g_i$ ($M_1^o=M_2^o=B[1+O(\eta)]$), and the bond average $\bar f(\rho)=\frac14[f(\rho-1)+2f(\rho)+f(\rho+1)]$.

Full grip, band regime $\max\tau_i\ll d$, with $d$ the distance of $\mathcal G$ from all other held levels of its parity class, joint flip included ($d_\times\simeq2n|g_1+g_2|-\frac32|B(0)|$, nonresonance (N×) $d_\times\gg\max\tau_i$): the band contract is (2.10)/(6.1) with error $O(\tau^4/d^3)$, and the gap of the double step of $b_i$ across the relative bond $\rho$ from $r=\rho\mp1$ is $\Delta_i(r;\rho)=2\sigma_iR_i+M_i^o(r)+M_i^o(\rho)+M_i^e(r)-M_i^e(\rho)$.
Local inertia of each body: $m_i(\rho)=\mu_i+\bar M_i^o(\rho)/c_i^2+O(|\mu_i|\eta\eta_j)=\mu_i+\bar B(\rho)/\tau_i^2\,[1+O(\eta)]$; (6.5) and (6.6) hold for the full grip.

In the class (band regime with the nonresonance condition (N×), binding regime $w\ll L$, tuned near-zero cases excluded), the selected level is bound at $r\approx0$ iff $\tau_1^2g_2+\tau_2^2g_1>0$ ($g_i=\sigma_i\gamma_iM_i$): lowest if both $g_i>0$, highest for opposite signs, never for both $g_i<0$; otherwise the extreme level sits at $r\approx L/2$.

$D_0=1/E_b''(0)-\mu_1-\mu_2=D^{\rm lat}[1+O(\tau^2/d^2)]+D^{\rm mark}[1+O(\eta,\tau^2/d^2)]-\rho_L/E''_{\rm line}+O(\rho_L^2/E''_{\rm line})$ in both parity classes, with $D^{\rm lat}=(\mu_1+\mu_2)(1-\beta_0)/\beta_0$, $D^{\rm mark}=(\tau_1^{-2}+\tau_2^{-2})\beta_0^{-2}\sum_\rho b_0\bar B\,[1+O(\eta)]$ (both carry $1/\beta_0$; valid for small $\beta_0$) and the ring-flux remainder $\rho_L=O(e^{-c(L/w)^{3/2}})$ for $w\gg1$, $O(L^2(w^3/4)^{L/2-2})$ for $w\lesssim1$ in the even class (not estimated in the odd class); narrow pairs have $\beta_0\simeq\frac{w^3}4\frac L{L-2}$ (even class) and $\beta_0\to\frac12$ (odd class); it is (6.8) with $s_c=+1$, $c_i=\tau_i$.
Cost of the bond: $\Delta E_0=\langle M\rangle_0+K_0[1+O(\eta)]$, $K_0=\frac14(\mu_1^{-1}+\mu_2^{-1})(1-\beta_0)$.

Item 3 (i), for every $w$ of the binding regime and both classes: $D_0-\Delta E_0/\tau_i^2=(4\mu_1\mu_2K_0/\beta_0)[1-\beta_0/(4\mu_1\mu_2\tau_i^2)]+\bar B_0/(\beta_0\tau_j^2)+(\bar B_0/\beta_0-\langle M\rangle_0)/\tau_i^2-\rho_L/E''_{\rm line}$ with the bond-weighted $\bar B_0=\sum_\rho b_0\bar B/\beta_0$, up to $O((\eta+\tau^2/d^2)|D^{\rm mark}|+(\tau^2/d^2)|D^{\rm lat}|+\rho_L^2/E''_{\rm line})$; $\bar B_0-\langle M\rangle_0$ is $O(\eta|B(0)|)+O(|F|/w)$ for $w\gg1$ but tends to $F(1-\frac3{2L})$ (even class) and $-F\frac{L-1}{2L}$ (odd class) for $w\to0$; the lattice term exceeds $K_0/v^2$ by a factor $\ge d^2/\tau_j^2$; for $g_1g_2<0$ the displayed terms are positive for $w\ll1$ and $1\ll w\ll L$, and there equality fails except in the limit of (7.8); for $g_1,g_2>0$ it holds only on a tuned surface.

Item 3 (ii), regime $\delta_m=|\mu_1+\mu_2|(1-\beta_0)/(|B(0)|(\tau_1^{-2}+\tau_2^{-2}))\ll1$ (which implies $1-\beta_0\ll\eta$ and $w\gg1$): $D_0=(\tau_1^{-2}+\tau_2^{-2})\Delta E_0[1+O(\eta,\delta_m,\tau^2/d^2,\varepsilon_L)]$ with $\varepsilon_L\le|\rho_L|/(2\eta_{\min})[1+O(\eta,w/L)]$, i.e. $2\Delta E_0/v^2$ for $\tau_1=\tau_2=v$, not $\Delta E_0/v^2$; it approaches $\Delta E_0/\tau_i^2$ only as $\tau_i/\tau_j\to0$.

In the band contract (2.10) with the fixed held source $g_s\Phi_{x_s}$ in laboratory coordinates (gradient error relative $O(\tau^4/(d^4\eta_{\min}\kappa_s))$ to $W_b'$), at first order in $g_s$ the source acts on the isolated selected band as the centre contract $h_c=E_b(\hat P)+V$, $V_{PP'}=g_s\langle\Psi_P|H_1|\Psi_{P'}\rangle$, up to $O(g_s^2/\Delta_{\rm rel})$ and bounded interband oscillations; $\Delta_{\rm rel}\simeq1.32|F|w$ for $w\gg1$.

For $w\gg1$, on the line chart of the relative place $h$ (ring closure error $O(e^{-c(L/w)^{3/2}})$), the internal state of the selected band in the midpoint gauge is $u_P=e^{i\Theta_P}v_P$ with $\Theta_P(h)=\sum_{ho\in(0,h)}\arctan[

In the same band contract, for $w\gg1$, $s\gg w$ and a start at rest in the selected band with real envelope of width $w_X\ll s$, the acceleration of the projected midpoint is $-E_b''(0)[W_0'(\bar X)+\epsilon|W_b'|]$, $\epsilon=O(1/(w_X^2\eta_{\min}\kappa_s),(\eta/\eta_{\min})w_X^2/(L^2\kappa_s),|\bar\nu|(1+|\bar\nu|)\frac{g_1^2+g_2^2}{|g_1g_2|}\frac{w^2}{L^2\kappa_s})$, up to exponentially small terms; $W_0$ is the midpoint-conditioned weight of the $P=0$ state ($g_s\rho_0(x_s-X)$ in the exact contract); the errors are below the bond's part $E_b''W_b'$ for $(\eta_{\min}\kappa_s)^{-1/2}\ll w_X\ll\min(s,L\kappa_s^{1/2}(\eta_{\min}/\eta)^{1/2})$ and a small third entry of $\epsilon$ (zero for equal bodies).
Weight gradient of a single held body on the ring: $W_i'=\phi'[ng_i+2\kappa_sC_i^{(2)}]$ up to relative $O(\eta^2)$, $C_i^{(2)}=-ng_i^2\ell_0/t_f$, $\kappa_s=(L^2(1-2u)^2+2)/(L^2-1)$, $u=s/L$.

Bond part of the weight gradient, with $W_0$ the midpoint-conditioned weight of (7.15) (kinetic contribution included) and the source at distance $s\gg w$ from the pair's midpoint: $W_b'=\phi'[2\kappa_sB(0)+\langle V\rangle_0-K_0]+O(\eta|B(0)\phi'|)+O(|F\phi'|w^2/L)$.

Exactly $\Gamma_{\rm pair}=(\mu_1\Gamma_1+\mu_2\Gamma_2+D_0\Gamma_b)/(\mu_1+\mu_2+D_0)$ with $\Gamma_b=W_b'/D_0$; $\Gamma_i=\tau_i^2\phi'[1-2\kappa_sg_i\ell_0/t_f+O(\eta^2,N_f\eta^2,\tau^2/d^2)]$; for every $w$ of S4, $\Gamma_{\rm pair}=(1+\rho_L)\beta_0\bar\Gamma[1+O(\eta,\tau^2/d^2)]$, which for $1-\beta_0\to0$ (so $w\gg1$, $\rho_L\to0$) equals $\Gamma_1=\Gamma_2$ iff $\tau_1=\tau_2$.

Fixed source, regime $\delta_m\ll1$, $\eta\ll\kappa_s$, $w/L\ll\kappa_s$, $\delta_m\tau^2/d^2\ll\kappa_s$, $\tau^4/d^4\ll\eta_{\min}\kappa_s$: $\Gamma_b=2\kappa_s\phi'/(\tau_1^{-2}+\tau_2^{-2})[1+O(\eta/\kappa_s,w/(L\kappa_s),\delta_m,\tau^2/d^2,\delta_m\tau^2/(\kappa_sd^2),\tau^4/(d^4\eta_{\min}\kappa_s),\varepsilon_L)]$, and the fall of a start follows it up to the further relative $\epsilon$ of (7.15); for $\tau_1=\tau_2$ the binding cost is weighed in the same proportion as its inertia, at leading order, only as $u\to0$, and at finite $u$, where $1-\kappa_s$ exceeds the remainders, less by $\kappa_s<1$, with $\Gamma_{\rm pair}-\bar\Gamma=4(1-\kappa_s)g_1g_2\ell_0\tau^2\phi'/(t_f(g_1+g_2))$; for $\tau_1\neq\tau_2$, $\Gamma_b=\Gamma_i$ only at the tuned distance $\kappa_s=(1+\tau_i^2/\tau_j^2)/2$, which exists iff $\tau_i<\tau_j$, and $\Gamma_b=\Gamma_1=\Gamma_2$ only for $\tau_1=\tau_2$ and $u\to0$.

At fixed $n,\gamma_i,M_i,\tau_i$: mark quantities scale as $t_f^{-1}$, lattice quantities as $t_f^{-2/3}$ ($w\gg1$), $D^{\rm lat}/|D^{\rm mark}|\propto t_f^{1/3}$, while $D^{\rm mark}/\Delta E_0\to\tau_1^{-2}+\tau_2^{-2}$ and $\Gamma_b/\Gamma_i\to2\kappa_s/(1+\tau_i^2/\tau_j^2)$ do not depend on $t_f$.

open_issues: The code has N_f = 1, so S5 is reached only at δ_m = 0.09 (S1) and 0.13 (S2), with L = 256; the remainders have sizeable coefficients (W_b′ − (7.10) up to 3.4 η|B(0)φ′|, the band contract misses 5–10% of D_0); the leading form of (7.12) is reproduced to 4–12% in S1 inside the S6 hierarchy and to 28–44% in S2, and at u = 1/16 the deficit 1 − κ_s is not resolved.
The kinetic weight −K_0 φ′ accounts for the difference between the exact selected level and the held-field average to 4–14% (S2), 9–30% (S1) and 16–45% (R); the excess grows with u and η.

The fall is simulated only in the band contract with the source (S1, S1u at L = 256); the exact laboratory contract is feasible only at L ≤ 16, where its eigenvalues confirm (7.14) but do not resolve W_0; that the exact density ρ_0 gives the band-contract W_0 is derived only to the order O(τ⁴/(d⁴η_min κ_s)) of W_b′, and numerically to ≤ 0.3% of W_b′ (L = 64, 128, s ≥ 8).

(7.15) is derived for w ≫ 1 and ε is an order estimate without constants; the code finds large coefficients of its start entries (16% of the bond part at s = 64, w_X = 12 in S1); near the pair (s ≈ 2w) the reduction is worse (5.9% of W_b′ at s = 4, L = 64); for w ≲ 1 the ring closure of the gauge (7.16) is not estimated.

The bound O(L²(w³/4)^(L/2−2)) on ρ_L for w ≲ 1 (even class) is an order estimate without constants; control F lies below it (ρ_L = 0.125 at L = 6, 7.6·10⁻³ at L = 8); in the odd class at w ≲ 1, ρ_L is not estimated.
Descriptions that violate (N×) (g_1 + g_2 near 0, e.g. g_1 = −g_2) would need a band contract on the group together with the jointly flipped sector; they are outside the class.
The factor κ_s is a property of the ring (zero mode); other geometries (tori) are out of scope.
c_i² = τ_i²[1+O(N_f η²)] is an estimate of the overlap corrections of (5.3), not derived in detail.
